title: Rabbi Reuven (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Shevuot 3:5: once Rabbi Reuven spent Shabbat in Tiberias, and a philosopher found him and asked, “Who is the most hateful in the world?” He answered: “The one who denies Him who created him.”
In Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer, chapter 42: Rabbi Reuven said, “All follows the head.”

notes.text: The supplied שינוי בעולם is understood contextually as “hated in the world.” The saved Machon Mamre Tosefta Shevuot 3:5 has שנוי בעולם. This supports the sense, without proving how the supplied spelling arose.
